name: Dockfan
summary: Group apps into one Dock stack that opens as macOS's fan
description:
Dockfan puts several apps in a single stack of the Dock. Click it and they rise in the Dock's own fan, with macOS's animation; it works even when Droppy is closed, and keeps every option of a Dock stack.

Pick the apps and their order, and how the tile looks: several apps on a coloured background, one app's icon, your own photo, a folder or the apps piled up. Each group gets a keyboard shortcut that opens its stack. Suggestions build a group from the suites already on your Mac, such as Adobe or Microsoft Office.
